options.content:
**Is Lands up, and is each land using it?** This board feeds the Health tab of the Project panel inside `/garden` (one solo panel per card, plan gd-gh5J0vVbJP step 4.1). The panel ids are fixed and pinned by the garden's embed registry, so **do not renumber or delete a panel**: add new ones with new ids.

- **Lands SLOs** (top, fleet-wide): the recorded SLIs of `gardenio/docs/lands/slos.md`. The burn rate is the error ratio over (1 - objective); `LandsSLOFastBurn` pages at 14.4 over 1 h and 5 m. The error budget left reads the 30 d recording and **ignores the time picker**. The uptime probes are the off-cluster prober's (`scripts/uptime-probe`), scraped from its metrics file.
- **Land API** (bottom): pick `project` (a land is the project of the same name). `gardenio_lands_api_requests_total` counts every Lands API answer by admitted `land`, contract `op`, problem `code` and `caller` class. Member calls in 7 days is the v1-beta exit's weekly-use read (`lands/contract/V1_BETA_EXIT.md`, criterion 2): operators and the land's own agents do not count. The land's Commons event lag and agent spawn-to-working are the two latency SLIs' distributions, cut to the land.
- **Farm: bird captions** (board only, fleet-wide, never embedded): where each bird's caption came from, the Haiku fallback's latency, spend and skips, and what an open transcript costs each viewer (plan gd-jMl4oF2cJO; switches `beadsViewer.captions.*`). The spend is priced from the tokens Haiku reported.

Sources: `gardenio:lands_slo_errors:ratio_rate*`, `gardenio:lands_slo:objective`, `gardenio_uptime_probe_*`, `gardenio_lands_api_requests_total`, `gardenio_commons_event_lag_seconds`, `gardenio_lands_spawn_to_working_seconds`, `gardenio_farm_caption_*`, `gardenio_farm_transcript_*`. The SLIs record only where `agents.metrics.prometheusRule.landsSLO` is on, and the probe series only where `vmagent.uptimeProbeScrape` is: an empty SLO panel means that, not a perfect month. Retention is 30 days.

panels.title: SLO burn rate
panels.description: How fast each Lands SLO spends its 30-day error budget: the 1 h error ratio gardenio:lands_slo_errors:ratio_rate1h over (1 - gardenio:lands_slo:objective), one line per slo. 1 spends the budget in exactly 30 days; the dashed red line at 14.4 is LandsSLOFastBurn's page level (with the 5 m window also over it). Empty means the landsSLO recording rules are off here, not a clean month.

panels.title: Error budget left (30 d)
panels.description: The share of each SLO's 30-day error budget not yet spent: 1 - ratio_rate30d / (1 - objective). Below 0 the objective is already missed for the month. An instant read of the 30 d recording: the time picker and the garden's range chips do not move it. Empty means the landsSLO recording rules are off here.

panels.title: SLO error ratio (5 m)
panels.description: The bad share of events per SLO over the trailing 5 minutes (gardenio:lands_slo_errors:ratio_rate5m{slo}): failed probes, 5xx answers, Commons events over 5 s, tenant agents not working within 300 s of spawn, #general messages unanswered for 15 min. The fastest-moving SLI; a spike here is what a page starts from. Empty means the landsSLO recording rules are off here.

panels.title: Prober last ran
panels.description: Seconds since the off-cluster uptime prober last wrote its metrics file (gardenio_uptime_probe_last_run_timestamp_seconds; it runs every minute). Over 600 s LandsUptimeProbeStale fires, and the probe SLOs stop moving: a flat counter burns nothing. Empty means the probe scrape (vmagent.uptimeProbeScrape) is off here.

panels.title: Uptime probes now
panels.description: Each off-cluster probe target's last result (gardenio_uptime_probe_success{target}): lands is /lands/ answering 200 and the page, garden is /garden reaching the sign-in redirect, commons_api is the Commons API answering 401 to a scripted call. The probes carry no credential, so up proves the edge and the sign-in check answer. Empty means the probe scrape is off here.

panels.title: Probe availability (window)
panels.description: The share of probes that passed per target over the selected window: 1 - increase(failures)/increase(probes), the same counters the *_availability SLOs read. The objective is 99.5%. Empty means the probe scrape is off here or no probe ran in the window.

panels.title: Land API requests by caller
panels.description: Lands API answers per second for the selected land, by caller class (gardenio_lands_api_requests_total{land}): member is a person of the land signed in, agent is the land's own agents with its token, operator is the fleet and its service tokens. land is set only once the map admitted the caller, so refusals before that (401, unknown land) are not here. Empty means no admitted call in the window.

defaults.noValue: no land API call in this window

panels.title: Member calls, last 7 days
panels.description: Lands API answers to the land's members over the trailing 7 days: sum(increase(gardenio_lands_api_requests_total{land, caller="member"}[7d])), the v1-beta exit's weekly-use read (lands/contract/V1_BETA_EXIT.md, criterion 2). Above 0 is a week of use; the land's agents and the fleet's operators do not count. Always the trailing 7 days: the time picker does not move it.

panels.title: Land API problems by code
panels.description: Lands API answers per second for the selected land that were problems, by problem code (code is the contract's problem code, or ok for a good answer, which is left out here). A rate of throttled (429) or forbidden answers shows a caller the land is turning away. Empty means every admitted call in the window was ok, or there was none.

defaults.noValue: no problem answer in this window

panels.title: Land API calls by op (window)
panels.description: Lands API answers for the selected land in the selected window, by contract operationId (op), every caller and code. Ops with no call in the window are left out.

defaults.noValue: no land API call in this window

panels.title: Commons event lag (p50, p95)
panels.description: Seconds from kbeads writing one of the land's Commons beads to the viewer's hub broadcasting it (gardenio_commons_event_lag_seconds{land}, by land and kind), the raw distribution behind the commons_event_latency SLO: its objective is 99% of events within 5 s, the dashed red line. The histogram's buckets run 0.1 s to 60 s, so a quantile reads to the nearest bucket. Empty means no Commons event for the land in the window.

defaults.noValue: no Commons event in this window

panels.title: Agent spawn to working (p50, p95)
panels.description: Seconds from one of the land's agents being created to the controller first seeing it working (gardenio_lands_spawn_to_working_seconds{land}, observed once per tenant-land agent), over the trailing day: the distribution behind the tenant_spawn_to_working SLO, whose objective is 95% within 300 s (the dashed red line). Agents are few, so each point is a day's spawns, read to the nearest bucket (10 s to 1 h). Empty means no agent of the land reached working in the day.

defaults.noValue: no agent reached working in a day

panels.title: Land API requests by land
panels.description: Lands API answers per second for every land the map admitted a caller to, one line per land, every caller. Board only (the garden embeds one land at a time): the fleet view of which lands are in use.

defaults.noValue: no land API call in this window

panels.title: Caption sources
panels.description: Bird captions the /garden farm made, per minute, by where each came from (gardenio_farm_caption_total{src}, plan gd-jMl4oF2cJO, spec section 5.2): a Bash description, a file path, a search pattern, a URL host, a subagent description, a built-in phrase, an MCP tool name, Haiku, Haiku's cache, or none (the bird keeps its tool word). description should be most of it, about 92% of Bash calls. A rising none with haiku flat means the Haiku fallback is off or skipping (see Haiku calls skipped). Counted once per call start in the viewer, not per viewer. Empty means the viewer has no captions build, or no gardener called a tool.

panels.title: Haiku caption latency (p50, p95)
panels.description: Seconds a Haiku caption call took, answered or not (gardenio_farm_caption_haiku_seconds), for a Bash call with no description. The call times out at 3 s (beadsViewer.captions.haiku.timeout, the dashed red line) with no retry; a bird never waits for it, and a late caption still reaches the transcript. Buckets run 0.1 s to 5 s, so a quantile reads to the nearest bucket. Empty means no Haiku call in the window: Haiku is off (beadsViewer.captions.haiku.enabled) or every candidate was cached.

defaults.noValue: no Haiku call in this window

panels.title: Haiku caption spend (window)
panels.description: What the Haiku captions cost over the time picker's range, priced from the tokens each reply reported (gardenio_farm_caption_haiku_tokens_total{type}) at Claude Haiku 4.5's list price, $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens. The spec estimates about $0.40 a day; beadsViewer.captions.haiku.dailyMax (5000 calls) caps it near $2 a day, and the LiteLLM key's own budget is $3 a day. The bill of record is LiteLLM's spend for the tag feature:bird-captions. Empty means no Haiku call in the window.

defaults.noValue: no Haiku call in this window

panels.title: Haiku calls skipped
panels.description: Haiku caption calls not made or not answered, per minute, by why (gardenio_farm_caption_haiku_skipped_total{why}): off (Haiku switched off, or no key), rate (over beadsViewer.captions.haiku.ratePerMinute, 30 a minute farm-wide), concurrency (over 4 in flight), daily (past dailyMax for the UTC day), timeout (no answer in 3 s) and error (LiteLLM refused or failed). A skipped call leaves the bird its tool word. Steady off means the kill switch is thrown; error or timeout climbing means LiteLLM or the key needs a look.

panels.title: Transcript bytes per viewer
panels.description: Bytes a second of live transcript rows (call events) sent to each activity stream that holds a transcript open (gardenio_farm_transcript_bytes_total over gardenio_farm_transcript_clients). Only a stream with the panel open pays for it. The budget is about 3 KB/s per stream (20 rows a second, spec section 11.3), the dashed red line; past 20 rows a second a batch says how many it skipped instead. The second line is how many streams hold a transcript open. Empty means no transcript was open.

defaults.noValue: no transcript open in this window
